verdict.rationale: Portkey's gateway configs clearly support policy-based model switching. Availability-driven fallback is well documented: a prioritized model list that triggers on non-2xx or custom status codes, plus circuit protection. Load balancing and conditional routing to different targets based on custom checks round out the routing rules. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of cost-based routing rules (only a marketing mention of 'smart routing'), concrete capability-based routing examples beyond generic conditional checks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
